name: Orduña-Urduña (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Orduña (a castle and a lion on red, within an inscribed bordure), between four white crosses patée in the corners.
history: Municipal flag of Orduña-Urduña; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Orduña arms — castle and lion within an inscribed bordure
crosses patée in the four corners
crown and castle of the arms
